rule_text: Block hardcoded credentials and prevent the agent from pasting secrets into generated code, logs, markdown, prompts, or responses.
safe_patterns: Use a secrets manager for production.
Redact secrets in logs and UI.
Keep `.env` files out of version control.
title: Secrets Management: Do Not Hardcode API Keys, Tokens, Or Passwords
unsafe_patterns: Database URLs with usernames and passwords
`.env` contents pasted into code or chat
Tokens in logs, screenshots, or generated docs
